decisions.reason: A is a renamed established trommel screen with positive market reception and low retention cost, so its option remains clearly valuable and unlikely to be dropped.
B has a dedicated page and several models, indicating sufficient market promise to keep the option open at modest cost.

D is still only a mentioned stationary fine shredder with a narrow niche and no strong positive signal, so while the option remains cheap to keep, there is moderate risk it will be pruned as uncertainty resolves.

E's overlap with the already-dropped C and absence of a dedicated page raise doubts about the mobile high-speed grinder platform, though the distinct green-waste segment still justifies keeping the option under review.
F has its own page and a model line, signaling promising market response and making its option valuable enough to continue.
